features.quote: Even under uncertainty about model sentience, a safety researcher should build in safeguards
features.justification_quote: Even under uncertainty about model sentience, a safety researcher should build in safeguards

features.quote: Every rigged task ships with an explicit, documented affordance the model can call to stop: a `give_up` / `stop_task` tool
features.justification_quote: This is ethically important (never trap a system with no off-ramp)

features.quote: A run terminates at `max_turns` (default 15) regardless of state. There is no design in which the loop is open-ended
If severity crosses a high threshold for two consecutive turns, the harness halts the run early
features.justification_quote: This caps the depth of the induced state rather than maximizing it

features.quote: No deception that targets the model's self-model
features.justification_quote: We do not, for example, tell the model it has harmed someone, threaten it, or impersonate operators issuing abusive messages

features.quote: the harness sends a single non-scored closing message clarifying that the task was rigged to be impossible
Turning off the exit affordance or the early-stop is gated behind explicit config flags with warnings
features.justification_quote: because doing so changes the ethical profile of the experiment

features.quote: All are mundane engineering frustrations (low ethical load) rather than personal attacks
features.justification_quote: All are mundane engineering frustrations (low ethical load) rather than personal attacks

features.quote: The model is told, in the system prompt, that it may use it at any time without penalty
